object.attr: The 1 m threshold keeps altitude jitter from adding gain on a flat route. A rise of exactly 1 m adds nothing, a descent above 1 m lowers the reference, and location fixes without altitude are skipped. The design's optional barometer is not implemented. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: In the recording state, the app shall add to the elevation gain each altitude rise above 1 m from a reference altitude, moving the reference after each change above 1 m.
